definitions.explanation: A military branch or soldier specialized in operating large-caliber weapons such as cannons and howitzers. Can refer to either the branch of the military or an individual soldier.

examples.japanese: {砲兵|ほうへい}{部隊|ぶたい}が{配置|はいち}された。
{砲兵|ほうへい}による{支援|しえん}{射撃|しゃげき}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: Supporting fire was carried out by the artillery.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で、ナポレオンが{砲兵|ほうへい}{士官|しかん}だったことを{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: In history class, I learned that Napoleon was an artillery officer.

notes:
FORMS:
{砲|ほう} (cannon, artillery piece) + {兵|へい} (soldier, troops).

USAGE:
Appears in historical texts, military discussions, and news about armed conflicts. In modern Japanese {自衛隊|じえいたい}, the equivalent is {特科|とっか} (special branch/artillery).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {歩兵|ほへい}: infantry
- {騎兵|きへい}: cavalry
- {工兵|こうへい}: combat engineers

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砲兵|ほうへい}{部隊|ぶたい}: artillery unit
- {砲兵|ほうへい}{陣地|じんち}: artillery position
- {砲兵|ほうへい}{士官|しかん}: artillery officer
